decision_target: Record the post-audit promotion decision for the Batch 45 comment-sufficiency advisory after M24 false-positive audit, M25 local advisory wiring and M26 live behavior eval evidence.

decision.reason: M24/M25 proved a bounded local advisory can run with reviewer-sized warning output, but M26 did not prove real AI-agent behavior improvement: treatment average was lower than baseline, treatment was worse on half of held-out tasks, one treatment run timed out and the independent reviewer decision was no_go.
decision.next_state: keep M25 advisory local, non-blocking and reversible; do not promote CI or blocker enforcement without a later owner-approved behavior improvement eval.

evidence_used.summary: Broad corpus audit inspected 934 Python/JS objects and produced stable warning_count 130, including 111 acceptable advisory, 9 false positive and 10 needs-rule-tuning classifications.
Tuned default advisory scope reduced visible warning_count to 30 with suppressed_warning_count 102 while preserving raw compatibility replay.
Approved local PostToolUse advisory replay stayed non-blocking: synthetic missing-comment warning_count 1 with blocking false, current changed-file warning_count 0 and V3 replay warning_count 0.
Approved live held-out eval ran 16 task runs plus one reviewer call: 15 completed, 1 timed out, baseline average 4.22, treatment average 3.88, warnings 29 -> 15 and reviewer decision no_go.

rollback_or_disable_path: Set B45_COMMENT_ADVISORY_DISABLED=1 to disable the local advisory.
Remove the comment_sufficiency_advisory.py PostToolUse command from .codex/hooks.json and .codex/hooks/hooks.json if the advisory must be fully detached.
Remove the packaged comment_sufficiency_advisory.py hook template only in a later approved rollback slice.
residual_risks: M26 treatment reduced advisory warnings but did not improve aggregate behavior quality.
One M26 treatment run timed out, so promotion evidence is weaker rather than stronger.
M26 did not provide actual provider USD cost from CLI output.
No CI or blocker safety evidence exists; promoting enforcement would require a fresh approval-gated eval and rollback plan.
unsupported_claims: Does not prove real AI-agent behavior improvement.
Does not prove enterprise-quality code in real projects.
Does not approve CI workflow creation or blocker enforcement.
Does not prove browser/runtime behavior, target mutation safety, installed plugin cache freshness, release readiness, deploy readiness or publication readiness.

required_before_any_promotion: held-out behavior eval with treatment average above baseline and no critical regressions
false-positive and flake replay for the exact promoted surface
rollback or disable path for any stronger advisory, CI or blocker route
explicit approval for provider/model/API, CI, browser, target, git, release, deploy or publish actions if used
